ps.brief: Puzzle 1, King: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Checks first: always scan for a check before anything else.

ps.brief: Puzzle 2, King: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: On an open board the King reaches checking squares from far away.

ps.brief: Puzzle 3, King: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Count the lines into the King; the King needs only one.

ps.brief: Puzzle 4, King: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: A check also takes away the opponent's choices.

ps.brief: Puzzle 5, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Safe captures only: make sure nothing can take back.

ps.brief: Puzzle 6, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: In a crowded position, check who defends the piece before grabbing it.

ps.brief: Puzzle 7, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: A capture that loses your King is not a win. Count attackers and defenders.

ps.brief: Puzzle 8, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Look for the undefended piece; that's free material.

ps.brief: Puzzle 9, King: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: No special trait here: the King's own movement pattern is the weapon.

ps.brief: Puzzle 10, King: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Know exactly which squares the King controls.

ps.brief: Puzzle 11, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: The King wins by geometry: find the line the defence forgot.

ps.brief: Puzzle 12, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Master the basic pattern before the fancy ones.

ps.brief: Puzzle 13, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Fork: one move, two targets. The King hits the King and a valuable piece at once.

ps.brief: Puzzle 14, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: When the King is in check it must escape, so the second target falls.

ps.brief: Puzzle 15, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Double attacks win material even against careful defence.

ps.brief: Puzzle 16, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Look for a square that attacks two things at once.

ps.brief: Puzzle 17, King: Capture the enemy King in 2 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Take the King in two: first remove every escape square, then strike.

ps.brief: Puzzle 18, King: Capture the enemy King in 2 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Pieces in front of their own King often become a trap.

ps.brief: Puzzle 19, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Calculate the whole line: the King wins material at the end.

ps.brief: Puzzle 20, King: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Forcing moves first, captures last.
